classification.difficultyReason: Students accumulate frequencies, choose graph scales, represent cumulative totals at class boundaries and construct the ogive, then translate the 75th position into an estimated mark using the taught graphical method.

inlines.text: 150 students sat a yearly exam. The results are shown in the table.
Draw a cumulative histogram and ogive, then estimate the median to the nearest mark.

spec.description: Empty axes and grid; class centres 5 to 95, cumulative frequency 0 to 150. No completed bars or ogive.

inlines.text: Total frequency: 150. Median position: 75. Estimated median: approximately 53 marks. See the cumulative histogram and ogive.

answer.worked:
The class centres are $5,15,25,35,45,55,65,75,85,95$. Adding the frequencies successively gives cumulative frequencies $2,7,18,35,64,98,123,137,146,150$; the total frequency is $150$.

Draw cumulative-frequency bars over the corresponding mark intervals. Join $(0,0)$ and the upper-right corners of the bars to form the ogive.

$$\begin{align*}\text{Median position}&=0.5\times150\\\text{Median position}&=75\end{align*}$$

Draw horizontally from cumulative frequency $75$ to the ogive, then vertically down to the horizontal axis. The estimated median is approximately $53$ marks.

spec.description: Unshaded cumulative histogram with a blue ogive and median-reading guides; source class-centre tick labels and cumulative-frequency scale retained.
